title: Standard 2-simplex triangulation as a concrete Triangulation instance

problemStatement.formal: \text{Verify the standard regular triangulation of }\Delta^2\text{ at resolution }m\text{ as a concrete }\mathsf{Triangulation}\text{ instance in the sense of }\texttt{proofs/Proofs/SpernerSimplicialInstance.lean}, \text{ providing }\mathsf{TriCell}\,m\text{ (}m^2\text{ cells), }\mathsf{triVertex}\,m\text{, }\mathsf{triAdj}\,m\text{, and proofs of the four Triangulation axioms.}
problemStatement.plain: The parent file SpernerSimplicialInstance.lean (994 lines, 0 sorries) hosts a Triangulation V n abstract structure with a 1-d intervalTriangulation instance (line 958) as the only concrete example. OQ-01 asks for the 2-d analog: a Triangulation (LatticePoint m) 2 instance for the standard regular triangulation of Δ^2 at resolution m. The construction uses lattice-point indexing, an inductive TriCell m with up/down constructors (T(m) + T(m-1) = m^2 cells total), and a case-table adjacency definition. S2 ACT estimated ~300 LOC into the parent file; 0-1 sorries (the strategic case is adj_vertex's image-equality verification across 12 adjacency pairs).
whyMatters: Closes the concrete-instance gap: the gallery currently has 1-d but not 2-d Sperner instances; 2-d is the canonical pedagogical example.
Provides the template for higher-dimensional extensions (3-d tetrahedra, generic n-simplex).
Reusable by future sibling slugs (triangle_chromatic_sperner, triangle_KKM, etc.).

knowledge.progressSummary: S1 OBSERVE doc-only: designed the concrete 2-d Triangulation instance for Δ^2 at resolution m. Locked LatticePoint m subtype (cardinality T(m+1)), TriCell m inductive (up: T(m) cells with i+j ≤ m-1; down: T(m-1) cells with i+j+2 ≤ m; total m²), and the complete adjacency table (12 interior pairs: 3 faces × 4 cell-pair shapes). Estimated S2 effort at ~300 LOC into the parent file with 0-1 strategic sorries (adj_vertex case explosion). Mathlib alignment confirmed: no new dependencies beyond Fin / Finset / Subtype / omega already in parent's imports.

insights: The 1-d intervalTriangulation template generalises cleanly to 2-d via lattice-point indexing plus an up/down inductive cell type.
Total cell count m² decomposes naturally as T(m) up-triangles + T(m-1) down-triangles, matching the geometric picture.
Up-triangles' three faces map to (hypotenuse, left side, bottom side); each is either adjacent to a down-triangle in a specific position or boundary.
Down-triangles are entirely interior — boundary 1-faces are all on up-triangles.
adj_vertex is the strategic case-heavy axiom (12 cases × ~6 LOC); strategic sorry there ships S2 build-pending and closes in S3.
mathlibGaps: Mathlib.Combinatorics.SimpleGraph.Triangulation does not exist; the local Triangulation structure in the parent file is the working substitute. No new gap introduced.
nextSteps: S3 (optional) — close strategic adj_vertex sorry if any.
